hero.subtitle: IT systems. Cloud curiosity. Practical AI.
hero.desc: I keep enterprise IT running and build what comes next. An IT System Administrator supporting 150–500 users, and an M.Sc. Data Science student at FAU Erlangen — connecting reliable infrastructure with cloud engineering and AI.
about.p1: I’m an IT System Administrator at **ABL GmbH** in Lauf, Germany. I manage IT for 150–500 users, from Microsoft 365 and Active Directory to endpoint deployment, network operations, and the hardware people rely on every day.
about.p2: Alongside work, I’m pursuing an **M.Sc. in Data Science at FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg**. My studies bring together machine learning, AI, and data engineering, including seminar research on self-supervised learning for dysarthric speech recognition at the Pattern Recognition Lab.
about.p3: I’m building on that foundation with **Azure, Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes**. My next step is a role that connects hands-on IT experience with modern cloud engineering. Based in Erlangen; open to the right opportunity worldwide.
contact.heading: Good work starts with a conversation.
contact.text: Looking for someone who understands the systems people depend on — and is curious about what comes next? I’m exploring full-time opportunities in IT, Cloud/DevOps, and Data Engineering. Open to international teams and relocation. Let’s talk.
